caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular fragments placed side by side, each containing a repeated pattern of various objects and nature elements. The color scheme is predominantly neutral with shades of brown and cream. Both fragments feature detailed floral motifs with large, overlapping flowers and leaves distributed densely across the surface. On each fragment, there are small log cabins depicted with horizontal lines representing logs and gabled roofs, with doors and windows visible. Alongside the cabins on the lower section of the right fragment, there are two barrels or containers set on the ground, and several pine trees nearby. The upper portion of the right fragment includes two cannons set side by side, facing rightward and located beneath a band of clouds or tree canopies. The floral elements surround and interweave between the cabins, trees, and cannons. The background is a lighter shade, allowing the dark brown details of the motifs to stand out. The pattern runs seamlessly from edge to edge within each rectangle, giving the appearance of a textile or wallpaper sample.
title: Historical Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
